title: DbCache doesn't working using MSSQL/SqlServer
body:
<!--
Please use this issue tracker for bugs and feature requests only. In case you need support please use one of
Yii communities listed at https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/wiki/communities
-->

### What steps will reproduce the problem?
Here I used basic template https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2-app-basic
According to https://www.yiiframework.com/doc/api/2.0/yii-caching-dbcache#$cacheTable-detail:

1. Create cache table
```
create table test_cache
(
    id     char(128) not null primary key,
    expire int,
    data   varbinary(max)
)
```
I used `varbinary(max)` instead of `blob`, cause script failing with error: '`Cannot find data type blob`'.

2. In db.php:
```
return [
    'class' => Connection::class,
    'dsn' => 'sqlsrv:Server=<server>;Database=<db>',
    'username' => '<user>',
    'password' => '<pass>',
    'charset' => 'utf8',
]
```
3. In web.php:
```
'cache' => [
    'class' => yii\caching\DbCache::class,
    'cacheTable' => 'test_cache'
],
```

4. In SiteController, in method actionAbout:
```
$cache = Yii::$app->cache;

return $cache->getOrSet('testKey', function () {
    return 122;
});
```

### What is the expected result?
On page '122' and the cache table row with key 'testKey'

### What do you get instead?
On page '122' and no rows in cache table

In the app.log found this:

`2021-02-24 18:05:05 [127.0.0.1][-][-][warning][yii\caching\DbCache::setValue] Unable to update or insert cache data: SQLSTATE[42000]: [Microsoft][ODBC Driver 17 for SQL Server][SQL Server]Implicit conversion from data type nvarchar to varbinary is not allowed. Use the CONVERT function to run this query.
The SQL being executed was: MERGE [test_cache] WITH (HOLDLOCK) USING (VALUES ('testKey', 0, 'a:2:{i:0;i:14884;i:1;N;}')) AS [EXCLUDED] ([id], [expire], [data]) ON ([test_cache].[id]=[EXCLUDED].[id]) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET [expire]=[EXCLUDED].[expire], [data]=[EXCLUDED].[data] WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ([id], [expire], [data]) VALUES ([EXCLUDED].[id], [EXCLUDED].[expire], [EXCLUDED].[data]);
    in C:\Users\kalymbekov\Desktop\yii2-cache-test\controllers\SiteController.php:130`

### Additional info
This issue may be related to https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/issues/16479

| Q                | A
| ---------------- | ---
| Yii version      | 2.0.40
| PHP version   | 7.4.14 nts x64
| Operating system | Windows 10 (1909)
